_doc: Pipeline settings. One record per diffusion LM. 'base' is its autoregressive origin (for CKA); null = trained from scratch (the control).
_n_test: 1319 = full GSM8K test. Lower it (e.g. 500) to cut generation time; record the value used.
_n_shots: The anchor paper evaluates math with 4-shot prompts (sec 4.4).
_models: Decoding settings follow each model's own recommended sampler, so they differ between models -- a stated confound. Dream: alg MUST be 'entropy' (its default 'origin' is random-order decoding). LLaDA: block_length is forced = gen_tokens (smaller values switch on semi-autoregressive decoding); temperature > 0 is required for N distinct candidates (its default 0 makes all N identical). A model may override n_shots and gen_tokens: diffugpt-s was adapted at context 512 (anchor App. B, training table) and every 4-shot prompt overflows it, so it runs 1-shot with 192 new tokens (0 of 1319 test prompts overflow; GSM8K gold solutions are 181 GPT-2 tokens at p99). diffullama's base is the ungated NousResearch copy of meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf: both safetensors shards and tokenizer.model have identical SHA-256 (checked 2026-11-02 via the HF API). All five models run 64 denoising steps for 256 (192) new tokens, i.e. 4 (3) tokens per step: Dream and LLaDA were cut from 256 to 64 on 2026-11-02 because at 256 each would need ~45 GPU-hours on the 700-question iteration-1 subset. Fewer steps lowers their accuracy -- a stated confound against their published numbers (ITERATION_1.md I-12).
_scorers: Small AR scorers for reranking (idea 1.1 names GPT-2 and TinyLlama). Run in a process WITHOUT attention_patch -- see score_candidates.py.
